core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rifaat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Elevation, dignity”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rifaat corresponds to the Arabic form رِفْعَة (Arabic root ر ف ع (r-f-ʿ); رِفْعَة (Rifʿa)). Its core sense is rifaat; elevation, dignity. Rifaat is Arabic رِفْعَة (Rifʿa) 'elevation, dignity', from the root ر ف ع (r-f-ʿ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave رفات (a non-standard form). The source gloss 'Elevated, Exalted, or Lofty' is broadly consistent.

persian.name: رفعت
persian.long_meaning: Rifaat (رفعت) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رفعت، بلندی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: रिफ़ात

arabic.name: رِفْعَة
